listings.Description: Are you a MS or PhD student interested in a 2025 Internship in Data Science? If so, we want to hear from you! We are looking for a customer obsessed Data Scientist Intern who can innovate in a business environment, building and deploying machine learning models to drive step-change innovation and scale it to the EU/worldwide.
listings.Requirements: Are enrolled in a Master's degree in computer science, machine learning, engineering, or related fields. Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent) is preferred. Experience with big data: processing, filtering, and presenting large quantities (100K to Millions of rows) of data.
